heavy-fault-regime.coincidence_condition: Any strictly increasing utility of benefits and strictly decreasing utility of costs must select a candidate that strictly component-wise dominates all alternatives.
heavy-fault-regime.interpretation: Empirical winner agreement is not mathematical score equivalence. Correlation and component-wise ordering must be inspected separately.
